ModelValidatorExternal.release_notes:
### Report Merging

- **New "Merge Reports" Action.** The Annex Report section now includes a **Merge Reports** button. It scans the current working directory for previously-generated PDF reports, lets you pick which ones to combine, and produces a single merged report — reusing the header, logo, and footer styling from the most recently edited report.
- **Merged Report Title Is Optional.** The title field in the Merge Reports dialog can now be left blank instead of forcing a default "Merged Report" title.

### Report Editor — Sheets

- **Sheet Switcher Replaced With Radio Buttons.** The report editor's sheet dropdown has been replaced with a row of radio buttons showing every sheet in the workbook at a glance, making it clearer which sheet you're currently editing.
- **Add New Sheets.** A new **+ New Sheet** button adds another blank sheet to the workbook directly from the report editor, without needing to import or duplicate an existing one.
- **Rename Existing Sheets.** A new **Rename Sheet** button lets you rename the currently selected sheet directly from the report editor.
- **Fixed Multi-Sheet Config Loss on Save/Export.** Saving, generating a report, or exporting a report config previously rewrote the config file using only the currently active sheet, silently discarding every other sheet in the workbook. All of these paths now preserve every sheet.

### Improved PDF Report Generation

- **More Reliable, More Traceable PDF Reports.** PDF report generation has been improved end-to-end this release: filenames, embedded metadata, and multi-sheet handling are now all consistent, so generated reports are easier to identify and no longer collide or silently drop sheets.
- **Report Filenames Now Include TestSuite ID and Sheet Name.** Generated report filenames include both the TestSuite id and the sheet name, so reports generated from different sheets no longer overwrite each other.
- **Report Metadata Embedded in Generated PDFs.** Each generated PDF now embeds metadata (TestSuite id(s), sheet name, mode, and generation time), which the new Merge Reports action uses to find previously-generated reports.
- **Sheet Checkboxes in the Testsuite Manager Now Refresh on Reopen.** Previously, a sheet added to a suite's report config after the Testsuite/Pipeline Manager was opened wouldn't appear as a checkbox until all test suites were reloaded from scratch. Reopening the dialog now rescans and updates each suite's checkbox list in place, without resetting in-flight progress.
- **Report Progress Now Reflects Actual Job Count.** When a suite generates reports for more than one sheet, its progress bar now fills according to how many of that suite's report jobs have actually finished — and shows which sheet is currently generating — instead of jumping straight to 100% after just the first sheet completes.

### Additional Simulation Options tab

- **Addition of Additional Simulation Options** Added Thresholds options under Additional Simulation Options tab in PSSE settings. Now user can set the Load Model Thresholds for the PSSE runs as per requirement.
